Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
October 14, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA

City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving Change Order No. 1 to the Hacienda Drive Storm Drain Replacement Project; and

C15.
S. Melrose Drive and N. Santa Fe Avenue Traffic Signal Interconnect (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , awarding a contract with DBX, Inc., for construction of the South Melrose Drive Traffic Signal Interconnect Project, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the agreement; and (RECOMMENDATION CONTINUED ON FOLLOWING PAGE)
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , awarding a contract with Lekos Electric, Inc., for construction of the North Santa Fe Avenue Traffic Signal Interconnect Project, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the agreement.

Vista Village/Broadway Lighting and Sidewalk Project (CC)
C23.
Loan Repayment and Acquisition Loan (CC/CDC)
1.
Community Development Commission repay $5,474,000 in existing loans from the City of Vista per terms of the existing loan agreements;
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , approving and accepting a Redevelopment Loan Agreement, Loan No. 2008-02, to borrow $5,474,000 from the City of Vista for acquisition purposes;
3.
City Council accept $5,474,000 in loan repayments from the Vista Community Development Commission per the terms of the existing loan agreements; and
4.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Redevelopment Loan Agreement, Loan No. 2008-02, to loan $5,474,000 to the Community Development Commission for acquisition purposes. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Land Acquisition - Purchase of 150 Broadway (CDC)
1.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , authorizing the Chairperson to execute an acquisition agreement with VUYTOWECZ TR for the purchase of the property located at 150 Broadway; and
2.
Authorize the Executive Director to execute the escrow instructions, deeds, leases, and other documents and actions required to complete the purchase on behalf of the Community Development Commission.
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Extension of Bargain Basement Store Moratorium (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Urgency Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Extending a Moratorium on Bargain Basement Stores in the Vista Redevelopment Project Area"; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , adopting and issuing a zoning progress report.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
